title: Frozen Bubble
tagline: Penguins shoot coloured bubbles: three of a kind fall, and the ceiling comes down.
summary: A penguin turns a launcher at the bottom of a frozen field and shoots coloured bubbles. A bubble sticks where it touches others; three or more of a colour together burst, and whatever hung from them falls. Every few shots the ceiling (alone) or a new row of bubbles (against someone) comes down, and a bubble that reaches the bottom ends the game. Take too long and the launcher fires by itself.

Alone you play the 100 levels in order or from any of them, random levels, or the multiplayer training, which sends you malus bubbles for two minutes and counts how many you send back. Two players share a keyboard: every group one of them bursts sends malus bubbles to the other's field. With chain-reaction on, falling bubbles that fit a group of their colour fly up into it and burst it too. The level editor makes levelsets of your own, which you can then play.

This is a port of Frozen Bubble 2.2.0 (2008) from its Perl and C source, frame by frame against the original. Online, two to five play one game over our server, as the original's network game: each player sends malus to the others, or to one of them.

original.author: Guillaume Cottenceau (design and programming), Alexis Younes and Amaury Amblard-Ladurantie (artwork), Matthias Le Bidan (soundtrack), Kim and David Joham (level editor)
original.platform: Perl with SDL_perl and a C extension (Linux, Mac OS X, Windows)
original.version: 2.2.0 (2008), the last release of the Perl game

controls.input: Up and Down (or Left and Right), Return

controls.action: Player 1 (alone, and right in two-player games): turn the launcher
Player 2 (left): turn left, turn right, shoot, straight up
Pause the game (again, Return, Space or Escape to go on)
Leave the game for the menu; in the menu, leave Frozen Bubble
Chain-reaction on or off (random levels, training, two players)
Chat: type a line, Return sends it, Escape drops it
Send your malus to one opponent, or to all
Music on or off, sound on or off (where the browser leaves these keys to the page)
Pick a bubble colour or the eraser, place bubbles (right button: erase), click the levelset and level commands
Left/Right previous and next level, Up/Down first and last, A append, I insert, D delete, [ and ] move the level, J jump, S save, O open, F1 help, Escape back
